decision_rule.BLUR_ROBUSTNESS_ESTABLISHED: PACT-minus-ACT collision-free-success point estimate is positive at every sigma>0, strictly increases at each successive positive sigma, and its 95% instance-cluster bootstrap CI lower bound exceeds zero at the largest sigma where pooled ACT and PACT are each >=0.10
